messages:
alex: quick idea — after the last P0 we still had 4 open follow-ups that drifted. proposing a small, standard action-tracker + IC rotation tweak to close the loop faster. thoughts?

maria: love it. can you sketch the tracker fields? i wanna see how it ties to timelines and reminders.

alex: sure — thinking minimal: action, owner, due, status, severity, recurrence(if any), linked pm/monitor, blocker? and a short acceptance criteria. like this:

```
action,owner,due,status,severity,recurrence,linked_doc,acceptance_criteria
Rotate certs for gpu-cluster,carey,2026-04-10,open,high,annual,docs/ops/gpu-cert,cluster accepts new certs without error
Add prefix-caching to long-tail model,alex,2026-03-30,open,medium,one-time,postmortems/1769000000,latency 95th reduces by 15% on replay
```

sam: +1. can we add an "escalation window" column? sometimes owners miss the due date and we need a clear handoff plan.

alex: good call. add `escalation_after_days` and `backup_owner`. also want each action to have an initial ETA + a hard SLA based on severity: high=14d, medium=30d, low=90d unless agreed.

nisha: ping on reminders — do we want to automate reminders in Slack or keep it manual? i can wire a tiny bot to DM owners at 75%/100% of SLA and post weekly summary to #eng-sre.

incident-bot: There are currently 3 open postmortem actions with due dates within 14 days. <https://redwood-internal/doc/postmortems/1769000000|See postmortem>

maria: @nisha please prototype the reminder cadence. i'd prefer both a DM and a weekly channel digest. also add an explicit "owner ack" step — owner must mark acknowledged within 48h of assignment or it's escalated.

carey: for recurring incidents pattern detection: can we add tags to actions (e.g., "networking", "model-serving", "kv-cache") so we can query and surface recurrence heatmaps? we should surface >3 events in 90d as a product-level signal.

alex: yes — tag + incident_id. later we can pipe to a dashboard. for now tags as free-text is fine.

sam: on roles and IC rotation: proposal: 1-week IC shifts, 2 backup ICs for weekends, monthly review of rotation load in retro. keep IC separate from owner to avoid conflict.

maria: agree. also add a "handoff checklist" for the shift: open incidents, oncall notes, pending postmortem actions requiring the IC's voice.

nisha: i'll draft a template doc covering: tracker CSV, slack reminders config, escalation windows, IC rotation schedule, and a sample comms cadence (initial ping, hourly updates while P0, afternoon summary, final postmortem note). i'll share a link when ready.

alex: perfect. timeline? can you share a first draft by Mon 2026-03-24? i'll volunteer to shepherd the first 2 weeks of the tracker to catch edge cases.

nisha: yep — will do.

carey: tiny UX ask — if tracker is CSV, ensure columns are stable and include an immutable action_id so we can reference in monitoring and alerts.

maria: also let's add a simple email/SLA notification for customers when incident actions affect external SLAs. note in doc.

alex: ok team — plan: @nisha draft by Mon, @alex shepherd initial run, @sam formalize IC rotation doc, @carey add tagging scheme. we'll review Weds sync and aim to close low/med actions within 30d for the first run. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Action created: postmortem-action-tracker-v1.csv (3 items) by nisha — https://redwood-internal/tools/action-tracker

maria: thanks — small follow-up: add a field `verification_proof` (link to prod check / runbook) so we can mark actions as verified instead of just closed. reduces reopens.

alex: done — include that. anyone object to weekly digest being pinned in #eng-sre?

sam: no objections.

nisha: PR incoming.
